verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or portability feature: nothing describes a bulk export of all account data in open formats, nor an offboarding or migration path. What exists is adjacent. The CLI and API return JSON for individual queries, and the MCP docs include an example prompt for generating a CSV. These are developer building blocks for assembling an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
